label: TP
reason: User input flows directly from request parameters through doSomething() into bar variable, which is included in the obj array passed to out.format(). The format string uses %1$s and %2$s placeholders that render user input literally into the HTML response without any sanitization or encoding.

evidence.note: User input stored in param, passed through doSomething(), assigned to bar, used in format() with %1$s placeholder
